title: Motion (Jurado – Nazarian) relative to results of water quality testing conducted on stormwater runoff associated with the Boyle Heights Lineage warehouse…
text:
[Council File 26-0906-S7]
Motion (Jurado – Nazarian) relative to results of water quality testing conducted on stormwater runoff associated with the Boyle Heights Lineage warehouse fire, as well as the status of the Cleanup and Abatement Order.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
summary: Council will address water quality testing results from stormwater runoff associated with a warehouse fire in Boyle Heights and review the status of cleanup efforts.

outcome.text: Energy and Environment Committee approved item(s) (Aug 18, 2026); Council adopted item, subject to reconsideration, pursuant to Council Rule 51 (Aug 26, 2026); Council action final
